pages.title: 6 - Learning Glyphs
pages.description: New Glyphs may be  created through the  Scribe’s Table from  certain items and  paying EXP. Once  crafted, the Glyph  can be consumed to  learn it, making it  available during  spellcrafting.   Players can share  their current Glyph  knowledge with each
other by crafting an  Annotated Codex.
